input: Replace the smoke-stained ceiling tiles in the kitchen

gold.taskTitle: Replace Smoke-Stained Ceiling Tiles in Kitchen
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to remove and replace smoke-stained ceiling tiles in their kitchen with new ones.

questions.title: How many ceiling tiles need to be replaced?
questions.description: Understand the total count or square footage of tiles affected to estimate materials needed.

questions.title: What type of ceiling tile system is currently installed?
questions.description: Determine whether the tiles are drop/suspended grid tiles, glue-up tiles, nail-up tiles, or another type.

questions.title: What are the exact dimensions of each existing tile?
questions.description: Identify the tile size (e.g., 2x2 ft, 2x4 ft) to ensure replacement tiles match precisely.

questions.title: Do you want the new tiles to match the current style exactly?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants like-for-like replacements or is open to a different look or material.

questions.title: Is this a DIY project or will you hire someone?
questions.description: Determine whether the plan should be built around self-installation or finding and coordinating a contractor.

questions.title: What is your budget for this replacement project?
questions.description: Establish a spending range to guide material choices and whether professional labor is feasible.

questions.title: Do you have a target completion date for this project?
questions.description: Understand any deadline or urgency driving the timeline for purchasing materials and doing the work.
